name: APC
query:
WITH date_list AS (
    SELECT %(start_date)s AS `date`
    UNION
    SELECT DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) AS `date`
    FROM (
        SELECT a.N + b.N * 10 + c.N * 100 + 1 AS n
        FROM (
            SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
        ) AS a
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
        ) AS b
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
        ) AS c
        ORDER BY n
    ) AS nums
    WHERE DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) < %(end_date)s
    UNION
    SELECT %(end_date)s AS `date`
),
pax_data AS (
    SELECT
        a.`name` AS `invoice_name`,
        DATE_ADD(
            DATE(a.`posting_date`),
            INTERVAL CASE
                WHEN TIME(a.`posting_time`) >= CONCAT(LPAD(COALESCE(rs.`hours`, 0), 2, '0'), ':00:00') THEN 0
                ELSE -1
            END DAY
        ) AS `date`,
        SUM(ABS(a.`no_of_pax`)) AS `no_of_pax`
    FROM `tabPOS Invoice` a
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    WHERE
        a.`branch` = %(branch)s
        AND a.`restaurant_table` != ""
        AND a.`order_type` != "Take Away"
        AND a.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
        AND a.`docstatus` = 1
    GROUP BY a.`name`, DATE_ADD(
        DATE(a.`posting_date`),
        INTERVAL CASE
            WHEN TIME(a.`posting_time`) >= CONCAT(LPAD(COALESCE(rs.`hours`, 0), 2, '0'), ':00:00') THEN 0
            ELSE -1
        END DAY
    )
),
item_data AS (
    SELECT
        a.`name` AS `invoice_name`,
        DATE_ADD(
            DATE(a.`posting_date`),
            INTERVAL CASE
                WHEN TIME(a.`posting_time`) >= CONCAT(LPAD(COALESCE(rs.`hours`, 0), 2, '0'), ':00:00') THEN 0
                ELSE -1
            END DAY
        ) AS `date`,
        SUM(b.`qty`) AS `total_dish`
    FROM `tabPOS Invoice` a
    INNER JOIN `tabPOS Invoice Item` b ON a.`name` = b.`parent`
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    WHERE
        a.`branch` = %(branch)s
        AND a.`restaurant_table` != ""
        AND a.`order_type` != "Take Away"
        AND a.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
        AND a.`docstatus` = 1
    GROUP BY a.`name`, DATE_ADD(
        DATE(a.`posting_date`),
        INTERVAL CASE
            WHEN TIME(a.`posting_time`) >= CONCAT(LPAD(COALESCE(rs.`hours`, 0), 2, '0'), ':00:00') THEN 0
            ELSE -1
        END DAY
    )
),
combined_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.`date`,
        COALESCE(p.`invoice_name`, i.`invoice_name`) AS `invoice_name`,
        COALESCE(p.`no_of_pax`, 0) AS `no_of_pax`,
        COALESCE(i.`total_dish`, 0) AS `total_dish`
    FROM date_list d
    LEFT JOIN pax_data p ON d.`date` = p.`date`
    LEFT JOIN item_data i ON d.`date` = i.`date` AND p.`invoice_name` = i.`invoice_name`
)
SELECT
    cd.`date` AS "Date",
    cd.`invoice_name` AS "Invoice Name",
    cd.`no_of_pax` AS "No of Pax",
    cd.`total_dish` AS "Total Dish",
    ROUND((cd.`no_of_pax` / cd.`total_dish`), 3) AS "APC",
    CASE
        WHEN cd.`date` = %(start_date)s THEN
            (
                SELECT
                    ROUND((SUM(ABS(`no_of_pax`)) / SUM(`total_dish`)), 3)
                FROM combined_data
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "Total APC"
FROM combined_data cd
ORDER BY cd.`date` DESC;
